Heh... Yeah. Let's go all out and make
some
noise..

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh-why do I needa relax? I won, so why
do I feel
so tense?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer. The party's gonna have to
wait.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'll be ready to celebrate in
no time.
No way I'm gonna stay a party
pooper forever.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Next time, I'll be ready. For
sure...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross vows that one day she'll
be able to
celebrate her victory with all
her heart. All I can
do is believe that day
will come.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, haha. Ya hit the nail right on the
head!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I'm way more relieved that
the race is
over than I am excited I won.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But... how come? I should be rarin' to go!
Ready
to tackle my next race head-on!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I can't be satisfied with just reachin' the
end! I
know the races up ahead are only
gonna get more
intense, so what gives?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Confronted with her unexpected
reaction to
victory, Tamamo Cross
experiences a mix of
sadness and anger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her shoulders trembling, Tamamo
Cross and
I have no choice but to
channel this energy into
our
preparations for the next race.
